title: Global Environment Facility (GEF)
definition: A multilateral financial mechanism established on the eve of the 1992 Rio Earth Summit to provide grants to developing countries for projects that benefit the global environment and promote sustainable livelihoods.
importanceInUpsc: GEF is the designated financial mechanism for five major international environmental conventions, making it a recurring theme in Prelims (Environment/IR) and Mains (GS-III: Conservation/International Agreements).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Global Environment Facility.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
